testControllerWithVerifier reaches upstream NATS server over loopback TCP with FileStorage; memoryMutations publishes real commits but reads only the in-memory map. No OCI/managed durable verifier, authority failover, production NATS TLS or real role workload is inferred.

Native roots are Linux/root/CAP_KILL/delegated systemd cgroup v2 scenarios with memory/cpu/io delegation and safe tenant executables. No current host resource/capability condition was probed. Ordinary-file cgroup emulation roots prove filesystem effects only.

Zero CgroupMemoryMaxBytes is allowed by runner.go:375–384; no missing finite-cap blocker is asserted. Native supervisor death parent and conditional helper are inside the same allocated whole declaration and parent owns live-process assertions.
